meta.name: subject-line-lab
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "generate subject line variants", "pre-score my subject lines", or "will this subject get truncated / trigger spam filters"; produces a labeled subject + preheader variant set and a per-variant heuristic pre-score card — spam-trigger flags, length/truncation across desktop + mobile, emoji-count, and the inbox preview render (from-name + subject + preheader) — before any test is run. Not for the body copy or CTA — use email-creative-builder; not for the A/B test design or significance read — use send-experiment-designer; not for the profile-weighted EQS or the S1/S2/N1/D1 vetoes — use email-quality-auditor. 邮件主题行生成/主题行预打分/截断与垃圾词检查

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成邮件主题行变体并预打分
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要为邮件营销撰写和优化主题行。
copy.tagline_en: Generate email subject line variants with pre-scoring
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often write and optimize email subject lines for campaigns.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会生成 3-8 个带标签的主题行+预览文本变体，并为每个变体做预打分：检查垃圾邮件触发词、桌面和手机端长度/截断、表情符号数量，并渲染收件箱预览（发件人+主题+预览文本）。最后给出排名和淘汰建议。
howto.when: 当你要求“生成主题行变体”、“预打分我的主题行”，或询问“这个主题会被截断/触发垃圾过滤器吗”时触发。

say.text: 帮我预打分这6个主题行，检查截断和垃圾词，发件人[名字]，促销模式。
say.note: Claude 会为每个主题行生成预打分卡。

say.text: 为[优惠]生成5个主题行变体+预览文本，冷外联模式，按预打分排名。
say.note: Claude 会生成变体并排序。

say.text: 显示我前3个主题行在桌面和手机上的收件箱预览，并淘汰任何截断承诺的。
say.note: Claude 会渲染预览并给出淘汰理由。

howto.what_en: Generates 3-8 labeled subject line + preheader variants, heuristically pre-scores each on spam triggers, desktop/mobile length/truncation, emoji count, and renders inbox preview (from-name + subject + preheader). Ranks and recommends cuts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to 'generate subject line variants', 'pre-score my subject lines', or 'will this subject get truncated / trigger spam filters'.

say_en.text: Pre-score these 6 subject lines for truncation + spam triggers, from-name [Sender], promo mode.
say_en.note: Claude produces a pre-score card per variant.

say_en.text: Generate 5 subject-line variants + preheaders for [offer], cold-outbound mode, rank by pre-score.
Show inbox preview on desktop and mobile for my top 3, cut anything that truncates the promise.
say_en.note: Claude renders preview and gives cut reasons.
